title: On the structural properties of Lie algebras via associated labeled directed graphs
summary: We present a method for associating labeled directed graphs to finite-dimensional Lie algebras that are $graph$-$admissible$. The proposed framework enables visual identification of key structural algebraic features. We first formalize this approach and establish several classes of Lie algebras that admit the categorization as graph-admissible Lie algebras, and then investigate suitable valid graphs for this approach by translating the antisymmetry of the Lie bracket and the Jacobi identity into rules that such graphs must satisfy.
